reasons: Cited Section 22 text satisfies every element of the preferred position: audit no more than once in any twelve-month period, at least thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours without unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1).
Cost allocation matches the preferred threshold exactly — Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and then only reasonable costs plus the undisputed shortfall (22.2).

The no-system-access requirement is expressly met: Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (22.2), and 22.3 adds further Customer-favourable protections.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed; the deterministic frequency check also passes. No actionable edit is warranted.
